subject: Capacity quarantine/reservation check — Stratagem AI (late-stage)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Capacity quarantine/reservation check — Stratagem AI (late-stage)

Team —

We have Stratagem AI (deal STRAT-2028-137) moving into final commercial review. They expect to run a POC starting ~2028-09-15 and target full prod by 2028-10-20. High level ask: 16 A100-equivalent GPUs continuously for the POC window (estimated 60 days) with ability to ramp to 48 GPUs at GA.

Can infra confirm current availability across our US Dedicated pools and whether we can place a soft quarantine/reservation for this opportunity? Key constraints:
- Soft reserve for an initial 45–60 day window, with automatic release if signed commitment not received.
- Prefer nodes in us-east1, but acceptable to spread across us-east1/us-west1 if needed.
- Need cost delta for earmarking vs on-demand (per-GPU per-day estimate) and any impact on other committed customers.

Attached: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_Strategem_v1.pdf (MVP scope & timeline). Please reply with a quick inventory snapshot + recommended reservation policy by EOD. If we can lock an initial soft-quarantine for 45 days, mark it as priority:tier-2 so we can escalate to tier-1 if terms convert.

Karthik
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity quarantine/reservation check — Stratagem AI (late-stage)

Karthik —

Quick inventory check attached (capacity-snapshot-20280729.csv) and a node mapping for us-east1 (node-mapping-az-east1.png). Summary:

- Us-east1 Dedicated pool: 120 A100-equivalent GPUs total, 92 available for new allocations today.
- Us-west1 Dedicated pool: 80 total, 38 available.
- Current headroom after existing commitments: 85 GPUs (all regions).

We can place a soft quarantine for 16 GPUs starting 2028-09-10 for an initial 45-day window (to match their POC start margin). Recommend the following policy:
- Soft-quarantine (non-billable) for 45 days with automatic release on day 46 unless we receive a signed MSA or Purchase Order.
- If Stratagem signs an LOI/term sheet with a 30% capacity commit within the 45-day window, convert to a provisional hold (billing starts upon conversion).
- Assign priority tier-2; escalate to tier-1 on approval from Karthik/Ben.

Fallbacks: If availability tightens, propose mapping to quantized-4bit variants (cost lower, throughput tradeoffs) or splitting across two AZs (12 us-east1 + 4 us-west1). Impacts to other customers are minimal under current forecasts; ops recommends soft-quarantine but with a hard cut date.

Action items:
- Monica to create the quarantine ticket in Capacity Control (CC-2028-STRAT-001) and tag as "soft-45d".
- Ben to prepare cost delta & provisional billing note for finance.
- Karthik to confirm if we should accept a 45-day soft hold or push to 60-day.

Monica Patel
Capacity Planning — Redwood Inference
Attachments: capacity-snapshot-20280729.csv, node-mapping-az-east1.png
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@stratagem.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@stratagem.ai
Date: 2028-07-29T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity quarantine/reservation check — Stratagem AI (late-stage)

Karthik / Monica —

Thanks for the quick check and the proposed approach. Stratagem is comfortable requesting a 45-day soft reserve. We expect to complete internal procurement and sign a term sheet within that window; target go-live Oct 20 still stands. For planning: POC throughput target is ~200 inference QPS sustained, which maps to ~16 A100-equivalents for our current model mix. If staging proves stable we will convert to a committed footprint of 48 GPUs at GA.

Two asks from our side:
1) Can you add language to the soft-quarantine confirming the automatic release date and a one-week notice to us before release?
2) We'll share a redlined LOI by next Tuesday; can you confirm the expected provisioning lead time once we convert?

DocuSign link for LOI will follow from our procurement team (you may see a notice from procure@stratagem.ai).

—Sarah Lee
VP Product — Stratagem AI
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@stratagem.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-29T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity quarantine/reservation check — Stratagem AI (late-stage)

Sarah —

Thanks — 45 days works. Monica: please create CC-2028-STRAT-001 and set soft-quarantine to start 2028-09-10; include an automatic release on 2028-10-25 with a notification to stratagem@stratagem.ai one week prior (2028-10-18). Ben, please finalize the provisional billing delta (earmark vs on-demand) and post to the deal record in HubSpot.

Monica: confirm provisioning lead time once they convert (we typically need ~5 business days to convert a soft-quarantine to billed reserved nodes, but call out any exceptions). Marissa: flag any overlapping near-term spikes in us-east1 that would affect this.

Karthik
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference
